title: Lattice Boltzmann Multiphase Solvers (D2Q9/D3Q19)
description: Mesoscopic Shan-Chen multiphase simulations for density ratios up to $1000:1$ and high Maxwell stress divergence. Video datasets capturing vortex shedding past micro-pillars and electro-osmotic ionic shielding in charge-regulated nanochannels are currently in post-processing and will be integrated here shortly.
